## A Water Route from the Forest Lodge

Anaconda Lake is mentioned in the Amazonian section of Anna's eight-day itinerary. Guests travel there by canoe along the Claro River after walking the trails around Jardim da Amazônia Lodge.

The highlight of this outing is the forest along the water and the opportunity to watch birds from the canoe. The excursion complements a walk through the natural surroundings of the southern Amazon and ends with a return to the lodge.

The name of the lake does not imply a guaranteed anaconda sighting: the programme makes no such promise. Details of the water route depend on the selected trip.

The route depends on water levels. In the dry season, itineraries may include the Santo Antonio and Tiririca communities and Tiririca Beach. During periods of high water, visits are made to Sobrado and forest areas around Parana das Araras.

During excursions, guides talk about large trees and local wildlife. Possible sightings in the jungle include sloths and parrots; along the water, visitors may observe animal tracks.
